item.name: Food_Surface_Sanitizer
item.description: PURELL Foodservice Surface Sanitizer, fragrance free, ready-to-use 32 fl oz spray bottle (3341-06). For food-contact surfaces, use it after cleaning and a potable-water rinse; keep the surface visibly wet for 60 seconds and let it air dry without rinsing.
item.readyBeforeUse: The bottle contains sanitizer and sprays.
item.ifNotReady: Ask the Dominatrix where to find a replacement. Turn the old bottle's nozzle to OFF, put the old bottle in 📦 Trash_Bins, and get the replacement.

problem.condition: The sanitizer is not spraying and the nozzle is OFF.
